name: @dropecho/interop
description: A library with interop / utils used by other dropecho libs.
author: vantreeseba <vantreeseba@gmail.com>

scripts.build:docs: rm -rf artifacts/docs docs/js docs/cs && haxe targets/docs.hxml && npm run build:docs:js && npm run build:docs:cs
scripts.build:docs:js: lix dox -i artifacts/docs/js -o docs/js --toplevel-package dropecho.interop -ex "^dropecho\\.interop\\.test" -D source-path https://github.com/dropecho/interop/blob/main/src -D website https://github.com/dropecho/interop --title "dropecho.interop API (JS)"
scripts.build:docs:cs: lix dox -i artifacts/docs/cs -o docs/cs --toplevel-package dropecho.interop -ex "^dropecho\\.interop\\.test" -D source-path https://github.com/dropecho/interop/blob/main/src -D website https://github.com/dropecho/interop --title "dropecho.interop API (C#)"
scripts.test:native: npm run build && npm run test:native-cs && npm run test:native-js
scripts.test:native-cs: npm run test:native-cs:build && npm run test:native-cs:run
